cache_module_read_completion.scope: Entire implementation and all embedded tests now read; supersedes prior partial cache scope.

native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Twelve focused groups, not full upstream suite.

floor_public_api_control.scope: Unmodified public SessionContext methods, finite in-memory histories; no hook execution

floor_pipeline_control.scope: Unchanged compute_rewrite pipeline in owned directories, synthetic Read payloads, manual floor transition matching cache field change; no real host hook

findings: Session-long skill/image/read lookups find the first matching fingerprint/path, then apply the dedup floor. After old call1 is fenced and same content is recorded at call2, old call1 shadows call2 and lookup still returnsNone.
Skill miss survives actual JSON roundtrip. Windowed lookup control instead finds matching eligible call2, distinguishing this defect from intentional floor refusal.

Original compute_rewrite pipeline control: first Read, manual floor transition, fresh Read,25 distinct noise reads, repeat target => no dedup marker; equivalent no-floor control emits a marker. No real host hook was invoked.
Original floor tests assert refusal of old entries and persistence of the floor but do not test a fresh identical entry shadowed by an older fenced one.
Cache record counts are capped on mutation, while loaded arrays and several session-long stores are not generally entry/byte-budgeted. No total-memory or adversarial-load qualification added.
transfer_decision: Do not copy first-match-then-filter lookup semantics. Only eligible entries can establish a reusable match. rrrah uses content/recipe/frame keys and does not implement this host-context floor model.
limits: Native115 focused tests do not qualify all host/plugin behavior or full package suite.
Owned finite pipeline inputs demonstrate missed reuse, not incorrect file equality or all compaction scenarios.
No rrrah production source changes this turn; native pHash.org/ASAN remains skipped.
